scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Cocos?
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
你猎杀够50只松鼠了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放弃

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
嗯，你好像还没猎杀够50只...

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Remember, I need help hunting Cocos so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
记住，我需要你帮忙猎杀松鼠，去杀够50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
确定要放弃狩猎吗？
目前的任务进度都会清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
好吧，改变主意了就回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Please kill 50 Cocos.
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
请猎杀50只松鼠。

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
真厉害，这么快就完成了！

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
I..I just can't seem to find any.
Pesky Coco's have hidden all the Acorns.
Do you think you could help me?
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
我...我怎么也找不到。
讨厌的松鼠把橡果全藏起来了。
你能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Oh, that's great! I knew I could count on you, just from looking at you!
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
哦，太好了！
一看见你，我就知道你靠得住！

scripts.text: Gather Items

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Can you help me find ^00CE0025 Acorns^000000.
I will reward you with much if you can.
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
帮我找来^00CE0025个橡果^000000，好吗？
找到了我一定重谢。

scripts.text: I have 25 Acorns
scripts.translation: 我有25个橡果

scripts.text: Please come again?
scripts.translation: 你说什么

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Oh great you found out where they were hiding them.
Gimme Gimme!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
太好了，你找到它们藏橡果的地方了！
快给我，快给我！！！

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Oh that's right, sorry I just love roasting Acorns. Mmm.
Here is what I promised you.
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
啊，对了，抱歉，我实在太喜欢烤橡果了。
嗯...这是答应给你的奖励。

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Where are my ^00CE00Acorns^000000?
Hey, I'm not playing, you better not hold out on me.
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
我的^00CE00橡果^000000呢？
喂，我可没开玩笑，别藏着不给我啊。

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
I need ^00CE0025 Acorns^000000.

[Nutters]
Ah, ok I think you can help me out by hunting some Cocos.
How many would you like to hunt?
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
好，那就帮我猎杀些松鼠吧。
你打算杀多少只？

scripts.text: 50 Cocos
scripts.translation: 50只松鼠

scripts.text: 100 Cocos
scripts.translation: 100只松鼠

scripts.text: 150 Cocos
scripts.translation: 150只松鼠

完成任务后回来找我，我会给你一点奖励。

[Nutters]

Can you get a little taller then return?

等长高点再来，好吗？
